summary: Milestone completed 2 synthesis-only experiments in 0.6 minutes; no compute-bound experiment was present. GPU efficiency and DualGPURunner engagement on compute-bound work therefore have no data available this milestone.
bottlenecks_identified: Timing attribution was limited to disk-mtime reconstruction after the live git-log path found 0 commits, so phase-level causes are unavailable.
improvements_suggested: Record task-scoped monotonic start, end, and phase timestamps directly in each artifact instead of reconstructing timing from disk modification times.
Retain sub-minute precision consistently so short synthesis-only work remains distinguishable.
Make accelerator recommendations task-aware, suppressing GPU and DualGPURunner advice when no compute-bound or parallel-model task is present.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add direct monotonic phase timing to the experiment lifecycle.
Add dependency metadata and concurrently schedule synthesis-only experiments only when they are independent.
Gate accelerator and DualGPURunner recommendations on task classification and model concurrency.
meta_reflection: GPU idleness is expected because all 2 experiments were synthesis-only and gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks is null. Better timing can enable future optimization, but the available data supports 0% estimated savings rather than a speculative forecast.
